items.html: And behold, the matter of the posterior of Tevuna, which we explained above, is that they too are the phase of the hundred twenty combinations of Elokim, as it is in the posterior of Bina. However there is a difference, for in Bina not all hundred twenty were revealed, only in the posterior of the four lower ones within it alone, in the secret of four times thirty combinations; but here, in the posterior of Tevuna, they begin to be revealed in all five lower ones within it, from the Gevura within it downward, for even the Gevura has the name Elokim in it. But in the Hesed within it, the name Elokim cannot yet be revealed within it.
